explanation: The cache status line starts with resident packed-frame RAM / projected RAM, then recomputation progress and ETA. Reuse a scene, not an ambiguous explanation. Respect real cells and the available viewport. Target one 45–65-column, 14–20-row specimen at a time. Use measured glyph widths and actual wrapping; crop and label wider virtual terminals instead of shrinking characters. Switch between frames when a comparison would otherwise become illegible.

Animate only a causal transition, and honor Motion. Prefer stable comparisons for appearance settings.
